parts.name: Brass nozzle 0.4mm
parts.description: The bit the plastic comes out of. Wears fastest of all.
parts.break_text: The nozzle has worn into more of a suggestion than a hole.

parts.name: PTFE tube
parts.description: Guides filament into the hotend. Degrades with heat.
parts.break_text: The PTFE tube has cooked itself. Filament is going nowhere.

parts.name: Textured PEI plate
parts.description: What prints stick to. Scratches and grease lower the grip.
parts.break_text: The build plate has the grip of a wet bar of soap. Nothing will stick to it now.

parts.name: GT2 timing belt
parts.description: Moves the bed and the toolhead. Loose belts mean layer shifts.
parts.break_text: A belt has snapped. The toolhead is now free to go wherever gravity suggests.

parts.name: Hotend assembly
parts.description: The whole hot end. Fixes the clogs that keep coming back.
parts.break_text: The hotend has given up being hot. Or an end.

parts.name: Hotend cooling fan
parts.description: Stops heat creeping up the hotend. A dead one means jams within minutes.
parts.break_text: The hotend fan has stopped spinning and started rattling.

parts.name: Part cooling fan
parts.description: Cools each layer as it goes down. Overhangs sag when it is weak.
parts.break_text: The part fan has blown its last. Everything now droops.
